title: Punctured products of root algebras commute with base change
statement: For every commutative ring R, element g of R, natural number m and family e:Fin m→N, let A_R be the finite product of R[t]/(t^(e(k))-g), let V_R=D(g) in Spec A_R, and let q_R:V_R→Spec R be its structural map. Then q_R is affine and locally of finite presentation. For every ring homomorphism phi:R→S there is an isomorphism V_R×_R Spec S≅V_S over Spec S, where V_S uses the same exponents and the coefficient phi(g). Empty products, exponent zero and empty basic opens are allowed.

proof.text: Each factor has finite presentation by AdjoinRoot.finitePresentation. Use Algebra.FinitePresentation.pi from Mathlib.RingTheory.Finiteness.FinitePresentationLocal for the finite product. The basic open is affine by IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen, its inclusion is locally finitely presented, and composition gives both properties of q_R.

Construct the individual tensor equivalences with AdjoinRoot.tensorAlgEquiv followed by AdjoinRoot.mapAlgEquiv and the tensor right unit equivalence. Take their finite product using Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight. Applying Spec and pullbackSpecIso gives a cartesian square of the unpunctured products. Identify the inverse image of D(g) with D(phi(g)) by PrimeSpectrum.comap_basicOpen and the structural-map equation. Paste the restriction pullback square with the product square and use its isoPullback; this proves the second projection identity. All cited equivalences and pullback lemmas are already proved in Mathlib.

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_root_product_base_change
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ) :
    IsAffineHom (puncturedRootProductMap R g m e) ∧
    LocallyOfFinitePresentation (puncturedRootProductMap R g m e) ∧
    ∀ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : R →+* S),
      ∃ δ : pullback (puncturedRootProductMap R g m e)
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ≅
          (puncturedRootProductOpen S (φ g) m e).toScheme,
        δ.hom ≫ puncturedRootProductMap S (φ g) m e =
          pullback.snd (puncturedRootProductMap R g m e)
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
